description: Everything about one item: what it is, its palette and fonts, region and industry, plan, the Herofold page to preview it, its cover image, the sections cut from it and related items, and which files (prompt, DESIGN.md, code) open on the free plan. Give the id from search; the type is optional.

id.description: The item's id from search: a page slug, a section (block) id, a component (motion) id or an AI dashboard (chat) slug

type.description: page, block (a page section), motion (an animated AI component or an AI platform screen) or chat (an AI dashboard)

name: get_item
title: Open one item
